parsed.post: Regression (0.9927 vs 0.9805). The increase to MATRIX_LR 0.06 at the current 262k batch size seems to have destabilized the configuration. Reverting to my previous best. Next, I'll try increasing the batch size to 524288 to see if larger batches provide better stability for the 0.05 LR.
parsed.description: Increasing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 262144 to 524288 to improve stability and convergence at MATRIX_LR 0.05.
